secret_ref_name_idx.name: secret_ref_name_idx
secret_ref_name_idx.where: "secret_ref"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_ref"."deleted_at" IS NULL

job_due_idx.name: job_due_idx
job_due_idx.where: hold_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('queued', 'running')

session_linkage.name: session_linkage
session_linkage.value: ("session"."principal_kind" = 'user' AND "session"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."subject_id" IS NULL) OR ("session"."principal_kind" = 'subject' AND "session"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("session"."principal_kind" = 'admin')

subject_tenant_external_id_idx.name: subject_tenant_external_id_idx
subject_tenant_external_id_idx.where: external_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

subject_tenant_email_idx.name: subject_tenant_email_idx
subject_tenant_email_idx.where: email IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

subject_addressable.name: subject_addressable
subject_addressable.value: "subject"."external_id" IS NOT NULL OR "subject"."email" IS NOT NULL

user_tenant_role_allowed.name: user_tenant_role_allowed
user_tenant_role_allowed.value: ("user"."role" = 'admin' AND "user"."tenant_role" IS NULL) OR ("user"."role" = 'user' AND "user"."tenant_role" IS NOT NULL AND "user"."tenant_role" IN ('admin','member'))

oauth_session_name_idx.name: oauth_session_name_idx
oauth_session_name_idx.where: "oauth_session"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_session"."deleted_at" IS NULL

task_hold_due_idx.name: task_hold_due_idx
task_hold_due_idx.where: hold_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('pending', 'running')

task_idempotency_uq.name: task_idempotency_uq
task_idempotency_uq.where: idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
